verdict.rationale: Datadog's docs say an llms.txt index exists for AI agents, and a hands-on probe confirms it returns HTTP 200. Doc pages also offer markdown versions aimed at agents (API reference, OpenTelemetry, MCP Server). missing for 10: independent community or hands-on corroboration of agents actually using these docs, and evidence of how complete the per-page markdown coverage is.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: For AI agents: A documentation index is available at /llms.txt.
For AI agents: A markdown version of this page is available at https://docs.datadoghq.com/api/latest.md
For AI agents: A markdown version of this page is available at https://docs.datadoghq.com/mcp_server.md
